Position :- Test Engineer/Senior Test Engineer 
 Experience :- 3 yrs – 8 yrs 
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 • 3 + years of experience in Switch Manual Testing.
 • Banking Domain knowledge.
 • Knowledge in Switch testing and ISO 8583.
 • Knowledge of SQL.
 • Experience in Test Reporting & Closure.
 • Experience in Defect Reporting, Tracking and Closure.
 • Test case review and traceability.
 • Experience in Prepaid/Wallet, Single/Multi Currency Card testing.
 • Knowledge of Transaction Level Reconciliation.
 • Knowledge of Network Settlement process will be an added advantage .
 • Knowledge of working on AS400 will be considered as an added advantage.
 • Scheme certification will be considered as an added advantage.
